sloka: गंगा त्रिपथगा नाम दिव्या भागीरथी इति च ।त्रीन् पथो भावयन्ति इति तस्मत् त्रिपथगा स्मृता ॥१-४४-६॥
transliteration: gaṁgā tripathagā nāma divyā bhāgīrathī iti ca ।trīn patho bhāvayanti iti tasmat tripathagā smṛtā ॥1-44-6॥

translations.english: O King divine Ganga will be called Tripathaga as well as Bhagirathi. Since she flows in the three worlds (heaven, earth and the lower world: Patala), she will be known as Tripathaga.
translations.hindi: ठ महाराज (भी) पितरों के उद्धार के लिए चिन्तत थे कि, इतने में नरशादूल दिलीप बीमार हुए और मर गए
